Jonas —

Quick notes after reading: good draft. A few suggested edits inline below for the questionnaire and a couple of clarifications for Acme.

- TAM deliverables: explicitly call out quarterly Business Reviews, one runbook review per quarter, and two tabletop exercises per year. That aligns with our Dedicated/Private playbook commitments.
- On-call: We should not offer 24x7 dedicated TAM coverage as standard — propose 24x7 escalation for Sev1 via Senior TAM + Ops Director, but Primary TAM remains Mon–Fri 08:00–18:00 PST with guaranteed overlap for Acme. If Acme requires a dedicated 24x7 TAM, we can offer as premium add-on (SOW impact).
- Incident comms: change initial Sev1 notification to '15 minutes to acknowledge receipt' for customers on SLA-backed Dedicated plans. Provide sample templates for 15m/1h/24h communication checkpoints in the Playbook.
- Evidence: add example deliverables list: incident timeline (T+4h), interim technical summary (T+24h), root cause analysis (draft T+72h, final T+7 days).

I've edited the questionnaire and added comments in the Drive doc. Karthik — please confirm the on-call rotation cadence (we typically do 1-week rotation for Senior TAM pager). Monica — can you attach a sanitized sample RCA we can include?
